notes: Static levels offered on the level selection screen. Paths are relative to this file.
A village with every NPC, two test courses with every kind of enemy and most kinds of object, and one arena for each boss.

entries.description: All five villagers, four of them merchants, with gems to spend on upgrades, and the six mini-game objects.
Stairs, stacked platforms, a pit, a lever and gate, a locked chest, and every kind of enemy.
Slopes and hills, platforms, a pit, a key and locked gate, and enemies.
A boss fight with the Undead Dragon: bite, tail sweep, gravefire breath and a dive.
A boss fight with the Undead Fenrir: fang snap, raking lunge, pounce and a howl that runs along the ground.
A boss fight with the Death Monarch: thrust, sweep, cleave and a volley of spectral blades.
